sources.title: UniFi Pro HD 24 - Tech Specs
sources.evidence_note: Official twenty-two 2.5 GbE RJ45 ports, two 10 GbE RJ45 ports, four 10G SFP+ ports and 60 W internal AC power.

notes: The source lists USP RPS DC backup in addition to an internal AC/DC supply; storage and physical fan capability are not established.
